title: ADR-0084: the type-to-group note, fold sentence and item 6 heading catch up with the knowledge_source row
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb4BAjgQ43tqy1DvVJ

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37304 (PR #37676, contract record 7206413701 nit N2, seat REWORK 7206423476), filed by the owning zone ai-37000 under #37304 at the seat's direction, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards. Handed to repo:objectstack#1 with the #37000 ledger (7206523866).
Grading: area:ai · domain:skills · Task · p3 (seat-directed) · reach: ADR-0084 prose · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：ADR-0084 加了“知识源”一行后，表下的计数说明、合并说明和第 6 条标题还是旧的，补齐文字。
- 谁受益：读 ADR 的人看到的计数和说明与表一致。
- 不做会怎样：文档自相矛盾；功能不受影响。
- 需要你做的：无（docs/adr 受治理，按惯例合入）。

## What

PR #37676 adds one ADR-0084 type-to-group row (`knowledge_source`, AI, 5, 高级) under amendment item 6 and nothing else. Still stale: the note under the table counts "AI 4" and 33 entries at its dated reading; the fold sentence names `ai_context` alone; item 6's heading names one type while two rows now point at it.

## Acceptance

- The note, the fold sentence and item 6's heading read true for the table as merged (dated amendment line if the ADR's convention asks for one); `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` stays green.

Blocked-by: #37304
